data.name: Shreekant
data.long_meaning: The name Shreekant is derived from two Sanskrit words - Shri, meaning God or wealth, and Kant, meaning desire or longing. Hence, Shreekant can be interpreted as the one who has a deep longing or desire for wealth and prosperity. It is also considered to be a name of Lord Vishnu.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the deep yearning and devotion towards the divine God of wealth and prosperity, Lord Vishnu.
data.numerology_meaning: A name that brings good luck, prosperity, and wealth.
